entries.name: Switch your phone's language
entries.summary: Your phone speaks the language from now on
entries.doesNotDo: It teaches interface words and stops. Within a fortnight you stop reading the menus at all and it becomes invisible.

entries.name: Write to one friend only in the target language
entries.summary: One person you only ever write to in the language
entries.trains: writing when you really want to be understood
entries.doesNotDo: Nobody corrects you and nothing is recorded. It is the highest-leverage entry in the catalogue and the app cannot see a single thing about it.

entries.name: Label the flat
entries.summary: Names on the things you walk past every day
entries.doesNotDo: Labels teach nouns on their own, which is the one thing cards already do well. You stop seeing them after a week.

entries.name: Watch one series only with target-language audio
entries.summary: One series you never watch in your own language
entries.doesNotDo: It relies on subtitles going off eventually. With them on, most of the hours go to reading.

entries.name: Think through your shopping list in the target language
entries.summary: Run everyday lists through the language in your head
entries.trains: recalling words in the middle of ordinary life
entries.doesNotDo: You will notice the words you lack and then move on without looking them up, so the gap gets found and not filled.

entries.name: Pursue one hobby in the target language
entries.summary: One thing you love, done in the language
entries.doesNotDo: It builds one subject deeply. Someone who can discuss climbing gear fluently may still be unable to describe their week.
